column1: # 原文\t譯文　　譯文欄留空 = 沿用原文；escape（\ddd）與 ^ 原樣保留
I don't think you should drink that^
It makes me feel GREAT!\255\003Smarter!  More aggressive!
column2: 我覺得棒透了！\255\003更聰明！更有侵略性！

column1: Just what I need for dissection lab tomorrow!
column2: 正好給我明天解剖課用！

column1: I think I need that for the band, Laverne^\255\003^you know, like we could bite its head off or whatever.
column2: 我想樂團會用得上那個，拉玟^\255\003^你知道的，像是把牠的頭咬下來之類的。

column1: He belongs to Weird Ed Edison!\255\003And it looks like he's brought us a note!
column2: 牠是怪異愛德養的！\255\003看樣子牠還幫我們帶了張紙條！

column1: It's from my old friend Green Tentacle^
column2: 是我的老朋友綠色觸手寄來的^

column1: He says that Purple Tentacle's mutated into an insane genius^
column2: 他說紫色觸手突變成了瘋狂天才^

column1: ^and Doctor Fred's going to kill them both!
column2: ^而佛瑞德博士打算把牠們兩個都殺掉！

column1: I thought I was free of Doctor Fred and those crazy Edisons forever.
column2: 我還以為這輩子再也不用碰上佛瑞德博士和那家瘋狂的艾迪生了。

column1: But now I know that I must go^
column2: 但現在我知道，我非去不可^

column1: `YOU'RE BRILLIANT.  WHAT A NOVEL DESIGN.  COME TO BALTIMORE AT ONCE.`
column2: `你真是天才。多麼新穎的設計。立刻前來巴爾的摩。`

column1: How could I improve on such succinct brilliance?
column2: 如此精煉的妙筆，我還能改什麼？

column1: That's only fun from a moving pick-up.
column2: 那要在開動的小貨車上才好玩。

column1: I won't be able to get it very clean without soap.
What am I supposed to do without water?
I can't do anything without something to scrub with.
column2: 沒有東西可以刷，什麼都做不了。

column1: Ah, it's clean enough for me.
column2: 啊，這樣對我來說夠乾淨了。

column1: Hi there?\255\003Is this Dr. Fred Edison?
column2: 你好？\255\003請問是佛瑞德・艾迪生博士嗎？

column1: Who did you think you called?\255\003Dr. Spock?\255\003Look, I don't have all day.
column2: 不然你以為你打給誰？\255\003史巴克博士嗎？\255\003聽著，我沒空跟你耗。

column1: This is Farley Krock at LucasArts Games.\255\003I just discovered your contract among some very old files.\255\003And, well, our lawyers say that we, uh^\255\003^have to pay you two million dollars in back royalties.
column2: 我是 LucasArts Games 的法利・克羅克。\255\003我剛在一堆舊檔案裡翻到您的合約。\255\003然後呢，我們的律師說我們，呃^\255\003^得補付您兩百萬美元的版稅。

column1: Uh, for the use of your family in the Maniac Mansion video game.
column2: 呃，因為《瘋狂大樓》那款遊戲用了您全家。

column1: No, I heard that, you MORON.\255\003When do I get my MONEY?!?
column2: 不，我聽到了，你這白痴。\255\003我的錢什麼時候到？！？

column1: Oh, right now.\255\003It's been credited to your Swiss bank account.
column2: 喔，現在就到了。\255\003已經匯進您的瑞士銀行帳戶。

column1: Operator!\255\003Get me a travel agent!\255\003This is an emergency!
column2: 總機！\255\003幫我接旅行社！\255\003這是緊急狀況！

column1: I'd better get this to Dr. Fred right away!
column2: 我最好馬上把這個拿去給佛瑞德博士！

column1: Where did you get this diamond, anyway?
column2: 話說回來，這顆鑽石你哪來的？

column1: Ah^\255\003^it was donated by a group of Girl Scouts who were in the neighborhood.
column2: 啊^\255\003^是附近一群女童軍捐的。

column1: Can we bring back my friends now?
column2: 現在可以把我朋友帶回來了嗎？

column1: According to my instruments, your lively friend in the future hasn't yet powered her unit.
column2: 根據我的儀器，你那位在未來的活潑朋友還沒把她的機器通電。

column1: According to my instruments, your rotund friend in the past hasn't yet powered his unit.
column2: 根據我的儀器，你那位在過去的圓潤朋友還沒把他的機器通電。

column1: According to my instruments, your friends have not yet powered their units.
column2: 根據我的儀器，你的朋友們都還沒把機器通電。

column1: We've repaired the primary device^\255\003^but before we can do anything, BOTH time pods must be energized as well.\255\003Then we can bring back what's-his-name and who's-her-face!
column2: 主裝置已經修好了^\255\003^但在那之前，兩台時光艙都必須通電。\255\003然後我們就能把那個誰和那個誰帶回來了！

column1: See, this is why I never wash my car.
column2: 你看，這就是我從來不洗車的原因。

column1: Where are you going?\255\003What about your experiment?
column2: 你要去哪？\255\003你的實驗怎麼辦？

column1: Even science sometimes gets called on account of rain, my boy!
column2: 孩子，科學有時候也是會因雨延期的！

column1: But how're you ever gonna get lightning if you're not gonna stand out in a storm?
column2: 可是你不站到暴風雨裡，要怎麼引到閃電？

column1: To be frank, which I am, I don't know.
column2: 說實在的——實在這回事我最在行——我不知道。

column1: ^much like your mind, apparently^\255\003^is still in a state of relative infancy.
column2: ^顯然就跟你的腦袋一樣^\255\003^都還處在相對幼稚的階段。

column1: Back to the drawing board, I say!
It's the breast pocket from the lab coat.
column2: 是實驗袍上的胸前口袋。

column1: That's the thing I'm supposed to push, I think.
column2: 那應該就是我要推的東西吧。

column1: Boy, that's a real sleeper of a book.\255\003What are you, some kind of geek?
column2: 天啊，那本書真是催眠。\255\003你是哪門子的書呆子啊？

column1: Unless it's lightning you're talking about, I don't want to know.
column2: 除非你要講的是閃電，不然我不想知道。

column1: I don't think he'd get it.
Nice rain coat.\255\003I wish I needed it, but unfortunately, the sun continues to mock me with its insipid warmth.
column2: 雨衣不錯。\255\003真希望我用得上，可惜太陽還在用它那乏味的溫暖嘲笑我。

column1: Sure, push me around while you can.
If you think I'm something to look at now, just wait.
column2: 你要是覺得我現在就夠看了，等著瞧。

column1: They look, and smell, a lot better from a distance.
column2: 離遠一點，看起來和聞起來都好得多。

column1: The lightning must've charged it up.
column2: 一定是閃電把它充飽了。

column1: It looks pretty much the same as Dr. Fred's motel.
column2: 跟佛瑞德博士的汽車旅館幾乎一模一樣。

column1: NOW, IN THE NAME OF SCIENCE, NOW!!!
column2: 現在，以科學之名，就是現在！！！

column1: Why didn't you wait for me to say `NOW`?
What part of the word `NOW` didn't you understand?
column2: `現在` 這兩個字你是哪裡聽不懂？

column1: Look, it's very simple:\255\003I say `NOW`, and you PUSH the KITE.\255\003Comprenez-vous?
column2: 聽好，很簡單：\255\003我喊 `現在`，你就推風箏。\255\003明白否？
